name.baseName: Crude oil, market mix, at long distance transport

dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: Calculation for transport distances assuming transport by pipeline offshore and onshore as well as sea transport in tanker. Sites and modes of transportation based on the supply situation in 2023. UUID=f83974a8-8a19-38ef-8928-b585fa048502

locationOfOperationSupplyOrProduction.descriptionOfRestrictions: Calculations include production and transport of crude oil from 27 countries.

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Operation of crude oil pipelines by electricity.

# Included processes
Transportation of crude oil from exploration sites to refineries in BE-region. Includes transport service requirements and emissions from oil handling and evaporation.
